help: promote what corpus-yoga agent capture staged into shared storage - each unit related to the held one of its address (new, identical, extends, ahead, diverged) and, where a family validates it, judged by the verdict the stage's rehearsal recorded, stage/rehearsal.json; copied over the held one where nothing held would be lost, the rest named; the stage is never written

args.name: --provider
args.help: every unit ONE provider's agent capture staged, or with --id one of them

args.name: --id
args.help: one unit of the provider --provider names, by a prefix of a component of its address under the provider (a session's uuid) matching exactly one; requires --provider

args.name: --all
args.help: every unit the agent capture staged, every provider
